description: This file implements cryptographically secure random number generation functions, including thread-local state management, hardware RNG integration, and entropy handling, with special support for FIPS mode.

methods.name: rand_thread_state_free
methods.description: Frees a thread-local RNG state, called when a thread exits.

methods.name: rdrand
methods.description: Attempts to fill a buffer with hardware RDRAND instructions if available.

methods.name: CRYPTO_get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Obtains seed entropy, using RDRAND if available, or falling back to system entropy in FIPS mode.

methods.name: RAND_load_entropy
methods.description: Loads external entropy into the global entropy buffer in FIPS mode.

methods.name: get_seed_entropy
methods.description: Fills a buffer with seed entropy, ensuring CRNGT compliance in FIPS mode.

methods.name: rand_get_seed
methods.description: Generates seed material for the DRBG, combining system and hardware entropy, with CRNGT checks in FIPS mode.

methods.name: RAND_bytes_with_additional_data
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes, managing thread-local state, reseeding, and incorporating additional data to protect against forks.

methods.name: RAND_bytes
methods.description: Generates random bytes with default additional data.

methods.name: RAND_pseudo_bytes
methods.description: Alias for RAND_bytes, for pseudo-random generation.

methods.name: RAND_get_system_entropy_for_custom_prng
methods.description: Provides system entropy for custom PRNG use, limited to 256 bytes.
